phase_prompt.label: Default State
phase_prompt.summary: The flock grazes and huddles in the desolate expanse of the Reset Desert, their forms illuminated by the harsh, vertical light of the simulation's noon. They are a singular mass of texture and nervous energy, grounded in the dark reality of the flat-earth plane.
phase_prompt.prompt_block: A photorealistic close-up of a flock of sheep in a desolate, rocky desert environment, illuminated by a harsh, top-down light source that mimics a studio spotlight. The sheep are crowded together, their wool detailed with dirt, straw, and the wear of the elements. The camera angle is low, eye-level with the animals, capturing the texture of their coats and the subtle steam of their breath in the cold air. The background is a blur of dark earth tones and sharp highlights, emphasizing the isolation of the group. The aesthetic is raw and dramatic, resembling a high-end nature documentary shot on an alien stage.
